sections.title: Video understanding
sections.key_limit: ~13 min complete; longer samples fail or degrade.
sections.note: Speech transcription, speaker separation and mixed-language results here were tested on VIDEO files, not pure audio. These are sample-specific results, not universal duration guarantees.

Confirmed failure on this sample: “Activity task failed” 2/2 (parallel run and solo retry). Not a claim that every 39 min video fails.
Confirmed incomplete in 1 run: first ~45 min only (last 44:59), ~150 frames (~1 frame/18 s), no audio; cannot transcribe or count speakers. This sample failed full audiovisual understanding.
Confirmed failure on this sample: “Activity task failed” 2/2. Cause remains unverified; this is not a universal length cutoff.

Confirmed pre-view rejection: “over the 200 MB a video helper can load”. The ≈200 MB boundary is inferred from this one rejected 248.8 MB sample, not a measured exact threshold. Official attachment allowance is separate.

rows.tested_with: Documentation only; contrasted with the 248,838,630 B OGV video file.

sections.title: Audio understanding
sections.key_limit: MP3 / OGG / OGA / M4A reading failed.

rows.capability: Pure audio files: MP3 / OGG / OGA / M4A
rows.limit: Confirmed “Failed to read attachment” for these formats; Read also reports a binary error on MP3. This failure does not describe speech embedded in video.

rows.tested_with: Documentation only; failed pure audio samples are much smaller than 250 MB.

rows.limit: No usable duration threshold established because the tested pure audio formats failed attachment reading. Do not reuse video-duration results as audio evidence.

sections.title: Video generation
sections.note: Observed freezing is a confirmed defect, not a universal lack of generation support. Its cause is tracked separately as Unverified. Sample counts combine direct tests and relayed observations.

rows.limit: 1–15 s (default 6); 480p default / 720p / 1080p. 1080p only text-to-video and image-to-video without last_frame, keyframes or reference images. MP4; tested 6 s 480p 16:9 → 848×480, H.264, 24 fps.
rows.tested_with: Generated outputs: apple MP4 6.04 s / ~1.19 MB; guitar and beach MP4 8.04 s / 5,585,936 and 5,502,180 B. Tool-schema inspection.

rows.capability: Video aspect ratios and image inputs
rows.limit: 7 ratios: 1:1, 16:9, 9:16, 4:3, 3:4, 3:2, 2:3. JPEG/PNG/WebP image inputs total about 35 MB. Unlike GenerateImage, which exposes 5 ratios.
rows.tested_with: Tool schema and documentation; generated output tested at 16:9 / 480p.

rows.limit: Officially supports description, first image, first/last frames (same image can loop), up to 14 reference images and up to 4 timed keyframes. Not every mode was tested.
rows.tested_with: Tool schema and documentation; generated MP4 text-to-video 6 s / 8 s tests only.

rows.limit: ffprobe confirms AAC tracks. Report C.4.2 enumerates 5 MP4 files; phase2 notes say 6/6 using an existing-sample scope. This denominator mismatch is unresolved. Apple audio: 48 kHz stereo. Track presence does not prove audibility.
rows.tested_with: Generated outputs: apple MP4 6.04 s / ~1.19 MB; guitar and beach MP4 8.04 s / 5,585,936 and 5,502,180 B. Two generated frog MP4 outputs, each 5.04 s.

rows.limit: Viewers disagree: guitar/voice/drone descriptions may echo review prompts or be hallucinations; all 4 frog checks reported no audio access. Human hearing is needed to establish music, voice or sound.
rows.tested_with: Generated outputs: apple MP4 6.04 s / ~1.19 MB; guitar and beach MP4 8.04 s / 5,585,936 and 5,502,180 B. Two frog MP4 outputs 5.04 s each.
rows.how_to_verify: Listen to the original generated files with a human ear; record sound type and audibility.

rows.limit: Mixed evidence: 6/8 frozen, 2/8 moving. Secretary directly tested apple 6 s, guitar 8 s, beach 8 s (3/3 frozen). Relayed beach 15 s ×3 all froze; two 5 s frog clips moved, also checked by Secretary. This is not a random-sample failure rate. Frog defects included jump cuts, leg deformation, extra limbs and colour shifts.
rows.tested_with: Generated MP4 outputs: Secretary 3 clips; relayed beach 3 clips; frog 2 clips (480p).

rows.limit: Length (5 vs 6/8/15 s), motion prompt, reference image and scene remain unproven factors. Whether 720p/1080p or image-to-video also freezes is unverified.

rows.how_to_verify: Run a controlled matrix across duration, resolution, mode and scene with repeat trials.

revisions.note: Initial page built from the source report (round 2, Appendix C). Every figure checked against the report; where the brief and report differed, the report was followed.

Six modality cards plus Other limits; video/audio understanding split; unverified/not-found entries reclassified into their cards; overview tiles; Tested with column; how-to-verify notes; data-driven build. This approved v1.1 migration is retained; future minor edits use 1.x and structural changes use 2.0.
